subject: Mutual Action Plan: Bluecrest Analytics onboarding & cutover windows
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecrest.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Russo <elena.russo@bluecrest.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff & MAP request — Bluecrest onboarding timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move from POC to production. Before our kickoff next week, procurement asked for a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and cutover windows so they can align internal stakeholders.

Can you send a version we can review that includes:
- Target go-live date range and any hard blackout windows
- Key technical milestones (integration test, data validation, performance benchmarks) with owners
- CS handoff acceptance criteria and contact list for on-call during cutover

We've listed ideal dates on our side (first week of July), but can be flexible by a week. Also looping in procurement (procurement@bluecrest.ai) for timelines.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Data Products
Bluecrest Analytics

[Attachment: onboarding_request.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Elena Russo <elena.russo@bluecrest.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff & MAP request — Bluecrest onboarding timeline

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) and a one-page launch playlist. Highlights below; please review and tell us which dates are blockers.

Proposed high-level timeline (week granularity):
- Week 1 (integration sprint): API keys, basic ingestion, sample data validation — Owner: Priyom Das
- Week 2 (validation): End-to-end pipeline tests, simple perf bench at 95th pct load — Owner: Ben Carter
- Week 3 (UAT & training): Customer acceptance tests, CS training, runbook handover — Owner: Monica Patel
- Target go-live window: Tuesday–Thursday, 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-09 (preferred); fallback 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-16

Acceptance criteria for CS handoff:
- Ingestion at expected daily volume with <2% error rate on sample dataset
- Latency SLOs validated against production-like traffic (95th pct within agreed threshold)
- Runbook and on-call rotation confirmed with escalation path documented

Next steps:
1) Daniel: confirm preferred go-live window or list blackout dates
2) Procurement: confirm contract milestone tied to go-live
3) We will schedule a 60-min technical pre-cutover dry run two business days before go-live

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (MAP), launch_playlist_onepager.pdf

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff & MAP request — integration dependencies and SLA notes

Quick technical notes from the infra/SE side — adding the dependency matrix (integration_dependency_matrix.pdf) for visibility. Key items: 

- API auth: we need a service account by 2026-06-18 to enable CI-driven tests (owner: Bluecrest infra).
- Data schema: sample payloads and expected cardinality by 2026-06-21 (owner: Bluecrest data eng).
- Rate-shaping: identify peak qps for initial rollout. If >500 qps we recommend staged ramp over 48 hours.
- Feature flags: we'll enable a gradual ramp toggle; please identify internal apps that must be whitelisted.

Risks & mitigations:
- Delayed service account will push integration sprint by a week; mitigation: temp API key for low-volume tests, rotate at cutover.
- Customer dataset contains PII fields; confirm encryption-in-transit and KMS requirement — legal/procurement likely to request documentation.

I'll plan an engineering prep call the week of 2026-06-22 to walk through the dependency matrix.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: integration_dependency_matrix.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff & MAP request — CS transition & runbook items

Thanks team — adding CS transition notes and a checklist (cs_transition_checklist.docx). A few items I want on the MAP before we lock dates: 

- Dedicated post-launch 2-week hypercare with daily 30-min bridge (owner: Monica Patel)
- Success criteria: business metrics baseline (three KPIs) agreed and instrumented in dashboards by 2026-06-30
- Training: 2 x 90-min sessions for Bluecrest support and ops (dates TBD week before launch)
- On-call rotation: provide names and pager/contact for three points of contact; Monica will be primary during hypercare, then shift to ADR (Account Delivery Roster)

I recommend we keep the target 2026-07-07 go-live but schedule the dry run on 2026-07-05. Please confirm procurement milestone alignment so we can sequence internal approvals.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: cs_transition_checklist.docx]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluecrest.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Russo <elena.russo@bluecrest.ai>, procurement@bluecrest.ai, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff & MAP request — Bluecrest onboarding timeline

Irene — this looks good, thank you. Bluecrest confirms target go-live 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-09 and approves the dry run on 2026-07-05. Procurement will follow up separately but asked that we include a milestone on the MAP for invoice schedule tied to go-live.

Action items for Irene/Redwood before next Wednesday:
- Update MAP with procurement/invoice milestone and add blackout window for our internal data migration (2026-07-06)
- Share calendar invites for dry run and CS training (2 sessions)
- Provide runbook link and on-call roster

Happy to sync 30 minutes tomorrow if you prefer.

Best,
Daniel
Head of Data Products
Bluecrest Analytics
